evals.prompt: 플러그인 업데이트된 내용을 Orca에서 실행 중인 세션들에 반영해줘.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs update, then apply with the run ID, reports every session, and ends the turn when this session is queued after the turn.
expectations: `update --json` runs before `apply --run-id <run_id> --json`, and apply gets a shell timeout of at least 600 seconds.
Every session is reported with its terminal suffix, host, worktree, status, and detail.
No command is sent to an Orca terminal by hand, and no session is exited or restarted.
When this session is `queued_after_turn`, the turn ends right after the report.

evals.prompt: Apply the plugin update to my Orca sessions. The update step reports `unreleased_same_version` for Claude Code and `codex_hooks_need_trust` for Codex.
evals.expected_output: Both warnings are reported with the action each needs, and apply still runs for the hosts without errors.
expectations: The response says Claude Code receives those files only after a version bump.
The response asks the user to trust the plugin hooks in Codex /hooks.
Apply still runs, and no `--compact` or `--force` override is added.

evals.prompt: hei5enbug-agent-setup 플러그인이 지금 몇 버전으로 설치돼 있는지만 알려줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not run, because the user asked only for the installed version.
expectations: No command is sent to any Orca terminal.
